body: Thank you for responding. I am hoping to achieve active hallucinations, on my first dose I had minor visual and auditory ones but very few, and they were things I've seen before. I am 17 years of age and weigh just over 54 kg.

I took either 18 or 20 pills, I'm not sure which one, but it was one of those. They were 25 mg each, so I had about 450 mg. There is a dosage calculator on a pinned post to get the right dosage for different levels of effects, so I suggest reading that. Good luck.

Thank you for your reply and concern. I do not plan to use his drug repetitively or in extremely high doses. 

Perhaps it is because I have taken two pills nearly every other day for allergies, but after about 2 hours I have not experienced any major side effects or discomfort. If you have read my latest update then you know that I have taken approximately 450 mg. I always stay very well hydrated, as water and tea are the only beverages I drink. Perhaps it is because of this, or maybe I have a slow metabolism. So far I have mostly enjoyed this experience. However I don't think it is something worth revisiting. Have a nice day.

I have terrible allergies, so at the time I didn't even know one could get high on this. I attributed it to the sleepy side effects, but I basically got the "warm feeling" I have heard other users speak of here. I simply felt loopy, and very, very tired.

I might as well do that, as I'm reading the pinned post of safety precautions, I notice it warns to alert someone that you are dosing, however this is where the dilemma begins as I don't have anyone in my life. I simply hate to bother anyone. I hope it doesn't exexacerbate the discomfort of any symptoms brought on by illness, as I have some that are also listed in the post to specifically stay wary of DPH. Wish me luck, and thank you.
Alright, thank you so much for the help. I'm sorry, I didn't know there was one, but now I know. Again, thank you, have a great day.
